premises.text: Musicians struggle to make a living due to low streaming income
premises.evidence_span: a band needs to stream for their songs. This is what they get for each one. So for a band of four to make minimum wage per year, they need almost 20,000 streams per day.

premises.text: Live music is a unique and unifying experience that can connect fans and artists
premises.evidence_span: live music is awesome. It's live, it's a beautiful, mysterious, and unifying force that connects us all.

premises.text: Spacebar provides a platform for musicians to connect with fans and receive support
premises.evidence_span: to help musicians to better connect with their fans and to build a mobile platform to help those fans that wish to support artists to directly do so.

premises.text: Spacebar streams live audio performances to mobile devices
premises.evidence_span: Spacebar streams live audio performances to mobile devices.

premises.text: There is a large market for live music streaming with many venues and artists
premises.evidence_span: in the United States alone, there are over 5,000 medium-sized clubs. And countless numbers of artists that play in them.

premises.text: The platform provides data to help bands plan their tours and venues book acts
premises.evidence_span: this is new data that the bands had never seen before, emerging bands had never seen before. And it will help them plan their tours.

value.text: Musicians can connect with fans and receive direct support through live streaming
value.evidence_span: to help musicians to better connect with their fans and to build a mobile platform to help those fans that wish to support artists to directly do so.

notes: No separate premises for partnerships or specific artist mentions as they do not change the core value proposition.
